title: Linux App Service runtime is not deprecated
predicate: For an explicitly selected native Linux App Service web app, compare its exact linuxFxVersion to complete regional Microsoft.Web webAppStacks metadata. FAIL on explicit deprecation or a passed endOfLifeDate. PASS requires exactly one matching runtime with explicit isDeprecated=false and no passed endOfLifeDate. Preview, early access, missing/ambiguous versions, custom containers, Functions, missing permissions and incomplete pages remain UNKNOWN. This checks the declared platform runtime, not application compatibility, patch level or the running process.
remediation: Select a currently supported runtime for the affected Linux web app, after checking application compatibility.
